title: BEST Jive Lesson EVER - 5 STEPS to get it down | Dance Insanity

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor uses humor, visual gags, and structured step breakdowns to teach jive basics. He combines technical instruction with exaggerated analogies and playful demonstrations.

lesson_structure.note: Step 1: Footwork using floor tape patterns
Step 2: Timing with number board and metaphors
Step 4: Leg action and knee pumps

metaphors: time is money with dollar and coin beats
knees like pumps working back and forth
common_mistakes: not timing the quarter beat correctly

steps_taught.name: basic jive footwork
steps_taught.description: basic rock step and chasse combination for leaders and followers

what_works: clear visual tape markers on the floor for foot placement
step-by-step breakdown separating footwork, timing, posture, and leg action
what_hinders: frequent comedic skits and interruptions slow the pacing of instruction

quotes.text: Step number one to get in the jive basic down is footwork.
Timing which is step two of learning the jive.
Since time is money, let's use the money metaphor to understand timing.
Step three, you're doing great jive, posture.

evidence_segments.observation: leader steps back on left foot and weight transfers to right foot on the floor tape

extraction.distinctive_method: uses tape floor markers shaped like Y-intersections combined with props like dollar bills and comedy skits to explain dance concepts
